steps.title: Body
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as lid.ipt.
Circle diameter 180 on the XZ Plane. Extrude 21 mm. Fillet the top edge 4.

steps.title: Hollow it
actions: Shell: remove the bottom face, thickness 1.8 (top 2). Fillet the inside top edge 2.2.
steps.note: Clear PP lets the patient and the carer see how many doses are left.

steps.title: Pod hole and collar
actions: Hole diameter 73 in the top on the centre. Sketch circles diameter 73 and 76; Extrude 10.0 mm down, Join.
steps.note: The collar closes over the O-ring on the pod.

steps.title: Hinge knuckle
actions: Sketch the lug and the knuckle (radius 3.5 at y 93.5, z 34) on the YZ Plane. Extrude 30 mm, symmetric. Hole diameter 3 along the axis. Save.
